name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm based in Arvada, a few miles from BOA's Denver headquarters, and I spend my own time outdoors around Colorado, so a chance to bring 15 years of marketing program execution to a company built right here caught my attention.

My background is B2B and agency marketing rather than consumer brand work, but the underlying discipline this role needs is one I've run for years: building training materials and onboarding programs that bring a partner network or a new hire up to a consistent standard (Birdeye, Wix), tracking campaign performance against KPIs and reporting it out in regular business reviews (Level Agency), and writing the copy and content that carries a brand's voice consistently across channels (Solenzo). I've also managed budgets and delivery for a high-value client portfolio while leading a team, so I'm comfortable owning a program end to end rather than just a piece of it.

What I don't have is direct experience in the outdoor or gear industry, or running athlete and event marketing specifically, and I'd rather say that upfront than have it surface later. What I bring instead is the program-execution and training discipline this role runs on, plus genuine local presence for the in-office connection days. I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that translates to BOA's retail and brand-partner programs.
